item.name: EXP Fruit (Small)
item.cardSummary: The entry-tier EXP fruit, fed to an Evomon for a small amount of experience without battling.
item.effect: Grants a small amount of EXP
item.howToGet: Earned from battles, quests, daily play, and redeemed codes.

item.name: EXP Fruit (Medium)
item.cardSummary: A mid-tier EXP fruit that gives more experience than the Small fruit, handy for leveling without grinding.
item.effect: Grants a moderate amount of EXP
item.howToGet: Earned from battles, quests, daily play, and redeemed codes.

item.name: EXP Fruit (Large)
item.cardSummary: The highest-tier EXP fruit, giving the most experience per fruit for fast leveling.
item.effect: Grants a large amount of EXP
item.howToGet: Earned from EXP Dungeons, weekly quests, beating or releasing Evomon, and redeemed codes.

item.name: Talent Vector Potion
item.cardSummary: Rerolls a captured Evomon's Talent, shuffling its boosted stats without changing the talent rank itself.
item.howToGet: Earned from the Season Battle Pass, Tower Ascent floor rewards, and redeemed codes.

item.name: Trait Reroll Potion
item.cardSummary: Changes the Trait of a captured Evomon to a different randomly rolled trait.
item.howToGet: Earned from the Season Battle Pass and redeemed codes.

item.name: Nature Reroll Potion
item.cardSummary: Changes the Nature of a captured Evomon, the third reroll potion alongside the Talent and Trait potions.
item.howToGet: Earned from the Season Battle Pass and redeemed codes.

item.name: Evolution Stone
item.cardSummary: The universal evolution material every Evomon needs, spent alongside the matching Element Stones at a level milestone.
item.howToGet: Buy from the Exchange Merchant (5 stones for 10 Exchange Tokens, weekly refresh), earn from island and Summon Ruins bosses, player level-up rewards, and Battle Pass rewards.

item.name: Element Stones
item.cardSummary: Type-locked stones that match an Evomon's element, spent with Evolution Stones to evolve. Each element has its own stone, such as the Fire, Water, Grass, and Electric stones.
item.howToGet: First-time wins against NPC Trainers (one-time, area-themed), island and Summon Ruins bosses, and regional bosses matching the element.

item.name: Omni Stone
item.cardSummary: A flexible substitute that fills in for any missing Element Stone during an evolution, with one Omni Stone counting as one Element Stone.
item.howToGet: Buy from the Exchange Merchant and Traveling Merchant, earn from Tower rewards, and claim from Battle Pass rewards.
